name: Eugène Carrière

summary.text: Eugène Anatole Carrière was a French Symbolist artist of the fin-de-siècle period. Carrière's paintings are best known for their near-monochrome brown palette and their ethereal, dreamlike quality.
summary.title: Eugène Carrière
